other_conditions: Applicant must have one of the disabilities covered under the National Trust Act (Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation, Multiple Disabilities).
Applicant must be from a BPL or LIG family, or be orphaned, abandoned, or belong to a family in crisis.
benefits_summary: Provides group home facilities, vocational activities, healthcare, and supportive services for Persons with Disabilities from BPL/LIG families, orphans, and families in crisis.
documents_required: Certification from competent district officials (if orphan/abandoned/family in crisis)
